On the first zombie hit of each swing, damage the nearest up to five other zombies within about two tiles on the same floor. Direct hits from that swing are excluded. Walls and doors do not block it. Each level adds 10%% of the weapon's average minimum/maximum base damage; hit-specific modifiers are not included. Disabling hides the enhancement entry and pauses the effect while preserving its level.

IGUI_GodSystem_AdminSetting_EnableUtilit: Master switch. Starting the device attempts both water and power supply; stopping ends both. Disabling hides new placement while existing devices and both account balances remain.
When enabled, supplies fixed vanilla piped-water fixtures and permits filling or drinking regardless of public water. Water is prepaid; unused water is refunded on stop or pickup. Enabled by default.
When enabled, the native generator runs regardless of public electricity. Fuel is prepaid and billed by actual consumption; unused fuel is refunded on stop or pickup. Enabled by default.
IGUI_GodSystem_AdminSetting_UtilityGener: Utility Generator Water Price per 100 L
System coins charged for each 100 L supplied, even while public water is active. Default: 20 coins. Price changes affect future refills only.
Utility Generator Electricity Price per Fuel Unit
System coins charged for each vanilla generator fuel unit consumed, even while public electricity is active. Default: 5 coins. Price changes affect future fuel reserves only.
